# Core paths: a pull request that changes these by more than 2 lines in total
# (added + removed, all paths together) needs an owner's approval of its
# current head. The `core review` job in core-review.yml reads this file
# through scripts/core_review.py. A breaking change to a pinned contract
# (scripts/contract_pins.py breaking) needs the review whatever its size, and
# so does any change to a path tagged `no exemption`.
#
# A section header tags the patterns below it, up to the next header:
#   [no exemption]  one changed line is enough to need the review
#   [bypass]        an owner may bypass their own PR with the `core-bypass`
#                   label when everything that needs review is tagged bypass;
#                   the merge then opens an issue for the other owners
# Both tags can share a header: [no exemption, bypass]. Patterns before the
# first header have neither tag. A path that matches a tagged pattern has the
# tag even if an earlier pattern also matches it. Any other "[" line is an
# error.
#
# Glob semantics, one pattern per line, paths relative to the repo root with
# forward slashes (gitignore style):
#   #            starts a comment line; blank lines are ignored
#   *            any characters except "/"
#   ?            one character except "/"
#   **           any characters including "/"; "**/" also matches no directory
#   no "/"       a pattern with no slash matches that name at any depth
#   leading "/"  anchors the pattern to the repo root (a pattern with a slash
#                inside is anchored already)
#   trailing "/" the directory and everything under it
#   a pattern that matches a directory matches every file under it
# "!" negation is not supported; a line starting with it is an error.
#
# Ring 1 (trust chain) is gated by CODEOWNERS with no exemption and is not
# listed here. The manifest spec, json_bridge, apply and the schemas are not
# core either: the contract pins catch a breaking change to them, and
# additive work merges freely. The pin snapshots data/contracts/*.txt are not
# core: additive SDK work regenerates them.

# R.* SDK: entry and submodules. Mods call these, so review is never bypassed.
src/loader/lib/**
src/loader/lua/**

# Deprecated aliases excuse removals from the pins
data/contracts/deprecated.txt

# Native headers, exports and the SDK tables generated from data/symbols.json
[bypass]
src/loader/include/**
src/loader/exports/**
src/loader/lib/*_gen.lua

# One changed line here (a symbol VA, a native hook) can break every user, so
# any change needs the review; patch day may still need it merged first.
[no exemption, bypass]
src/loader/src/**
data/symbols.json
